map.由声功率求声功率级（W₀=10⁻¹² W） 使用指南: Sound Power Level from Sound Power (W₀=10⁻¹² W) User Guide
map.输入声功率值，以参考功率 W₀=10⁻¹² W 按 10·log₁₀(W/W₀): Enter the sound power and, using the reference power W₀=10⁻¹² W, compute the sound power level in dB from 10·log₁₀(W/W₀), used for equipment noise rating, sound power declarations, and comparison against environmental limits.
map.输入声功率，求声功率级。: Enter the sound power to get the sound power level.
map.设备声功率 W 换算声功率级 Lw=10·log10(W/W0)，W0=10⁻¹: Convert equipment sound power W to sound power level Lw=10·log10(W/W0), with W0=10⁻¹² W.
map.不同设备声功率级直接相加得总声功率级。: Add the sound power levels of different equipment directly to get the total sound power level.
map.产品噪声标称中统一到 Lw 刻度。: Product noise ratings are standardized onto the Lw scale.
map.：设备声功率 W=0.001 W，W0=10⁻¹² W，Lw=10·log10(: : With equipment sound power W=0.001 W and W0=10⁻¹² W, Lw=10·log10(1e9)=90 dB.
map.由声压求声压级（p₀=20 µPa）: Sound Pressure Level from Sound Pressure (p₀=20 µPa)
map.声功率级和距离有关吗？: Does Sound Power Level Depend on Distance?
map.无关：声功率级描述源本身，不随测点距离变化；声压级才随距离变。: Unrelated: sound power level describes the source itself and does not vary with measurement distance; only sound pressure level changes with distance.
map.先转回功率求和再取对数：Lw_total=10·log10(Σ10^(Lwi/1: First convert back to power, sum, then take the logarithm: Lw_total=10·log10(Σ10^(Lwi/10)).
